description: Source code for GhostJetbrainsBridge class and related functions, implementing a bridge for inline code completions in JetBrains IDEs using VSCode API and custom logic.

classes.name: GhostJetbrainsBridge
classes.description: Class providing a bridge for inline code completions in JetBrains IDEs, handling argument parsing, content normalization, mock document creation, and invoking VSCode inline completion provider.

methods.name: determineLanguage
methods.description: Determines the language ID based on provided langId or file extension.

methods.name: parseAndValidateArgs
methods.description: Parses and validates RPC arguments using Zod schemas.

methods.name: normalizeContent
methods.description: Normalizes line endings in file content to LF.

methods.name: createMockDocument
methods.description: Creates a mock VSCode TextDocument with specified URI, content, and language.

methods.name: createMockContextProvider
methods.description: Creates a mock context provider to prevent workspace file access, used for JetBrains bridge.

methods.name: serializeCompletionResult
methods.description: Serializes inline completion items into a RPC response format.

methods.name: getInlineCompletions
methods.description: Main method to process arguments, create mock document, invoke inline completion provider, and return results.
